items.title: Being Gorenstein is preserved and reflected by dividing by a nonzerodivisor
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file dualizing.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement says that for a nonzerodivisor in the maximal ideal of a Noetherian local ring the ring is Gorenstein exactly when the quotient by that element is (author lemma at source lines 4108-4113, label lemma-gorenstein-divide-by-nonzerodivisor). The proof (source lines 4116-4133) takes the forward implication from the preservation statement, and for the converse rewrites the Ext modules of the residue field over the source by adjunction along the quotient map, using that the internal hom out of the quotient is the quotient shifted by one, so that eventual vanishing over the quotient transfers to the source and the vanishing criterion applies (proof lines 4119-4132). The adjunction computation is the substance. H3.
